scope_note: This dataset covers GENERAL (typically nationwide-consistent) licensing/permit requirements only. State-specific variations are addressed separately in Layer B. All claims use 'commonly'/'typically' phrasing unless a fact is established federal law. This category includes solo/home-based consultants, business coaches, life coaches, and similar independent advisory professionals who are NOT practicing a state-regulated profession.

federal_requirements.requirement_name: Employer Identification Number (EIN) / Federal Tax ID
federal_requirements.why_needed: An EIN is a federal tax ID number used by the IRS to identify business entities for tax filing purposes. A sole proprietor who has no employees is not strictly required to obtain an EIN (they can use their SSN for business tax filing), but it is commonly recommended — especially to open a business bank account, protect the owner's SSN from identity theft, and prepare for future hiring.
federal_requirements.how_commonly_required: Required when the business has employees, operates as a partnership or corporation, or files certain federal tax returns (e.g., excise tax). Not strictly required for a sole proprietor with no employees, but commonly obtained. Free; issued immediately when applied for online.
